mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. Tonight we are experiencing clear skies and a comfortable 69 degrees over Harriet Park, feeling like 71. We have a lovely waxing crescent moon visible tonight, although there will be no visible passes of the International Space Station.

In city news, Verona is continuing its commitment to sustainability. The City Hall and street lights on Verona Avenue are being upgraded to energy-saving LED lights, and Alliant Energy is promoting community solar options for residents who want renewable energy without installing panels.

For local events, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard on Friday, July 17th. Looking ahead to Saturday, July 18th, the Mount Horeb Art Fair will showcase talented Midwestern artists in their historic downtown.

According to the weekly police report, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way. A 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield the right-of-way, and a 74-year-old woman was treated for minor injuries.
To wrap things up, the Verona Culver's is currently closed but will reopen at 10:00 AM. Today's featured Flavor of the Day is Snickers Swirl, followed by Mint Cookie tomorrow.
